title: Fuselage — Aft Lower Shell — Replacement of Inner Doublers by Titanium Items with a Drain Relief

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: In-service replacement of the aft lower shell inner doublers by titanium items with a machined drain relief, bringing delivered aircraft to the standard that has been in production since MSN C00243.

sections.planning_reason: Aircraft delivered before the production cut-in carry aluminium inner doublers in the aft lower shell joint land, where condensate collects on short-sector operation. Twenty-two aircraft were reported with surface corrosion on the doubler flange and four of those were beyond the blend-out limit of the applicable repair scheme. The scheduled detailed visual inspection of the joint land introduced with the interim sealing standard cannot be withdrawn until the joint drains properly, and it costs about eighteen manhours at every C-check.
sections.description: The aluminium inner doublers at the longitudinal joints between stations C52 and C66 are removed and replaced by titanium items with a machined relief along the lower flange that forms a continuous drain path to the existing bilge outlets. The joint angle is replaced at the same time so that both parts share one fastener pattern, and the joint is refastened and re-sealed to the standard practice of ATA 51-20.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Get access to the aft cargo compartment, remove the cargo lining panels and lift the cargo floor panels between stations C52 and C66. Do the eddy current inspection of the joint land if the inspection bulletin has not already been accomplished. Remove the existing inner doubler and the joint angle. Do a detailed visual inspection of the exposed skin land and record any finding before further work. Ream the fastener holes to the new pattern using the drill jig and do an eddy current inspection of every reamed hole. Install the titanium doubler D5331121169495 and the joint angle D5331122892194 wet with sealant and fasten with rivets EN545167-02. Install washers AGS334024-84 at the drain grommet positions and check that each drain path is clear with a water flow test. Restore the protective treatment. Install the cargo floor and lining panels and do the cargo compartment lighting check. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft MSN C00001 through C00239 that have not been brought to the corrosion-resistant doubler standard in production. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00243 onward are already at the standard and are not affected. Two withdrawn aircraft are excluded.
sections.material_note: Kit K5331-1042-01 contains the two doublers, the two joint angles, the fastener set and the consumables. Lead time is twenty-two weeks from order. Removed aluminium doublers are not returned and may be scrapped locally once the embodiment is recorded.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 60 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Eddy current inspection of reamed holes made mandatory; drain path water flow test added after step 9; two withdrawn aircraft removed from the effectivity
